verdict.rationale: Kit documents two V4 authentication mechanisms: OAuth 2.0 for App Store apps and API keys for your own account, plus OAuth token revocation. Nothing in the pack mentions scopes, read-only keys, or permission levels that would let an ops user give an agent or contractor analytics read access without the ability to create or send broadcasts. The Kit MCP is described as read *and* write, so it does not fill this gap either.
